description:
Manage Focus workspace-settings with the following actions:

- **workspace-settings-list**: List user workspace settings. (data: none)
- **workspace-settings-partial-update**: Update user workspace settings. (data: payload*{has_opened_focus, onboarding_intent, onboarding_invited_user_ids, onboarding_project_id, onboarding_step, onboarding_task_id, onboarding_team_size, work_introduction_dismissed})
- **get-user-permissions** (data: none)
- **get-workspace-currency** (data: none)
- **get-workspace-export-branding** (data: none)
- **get-workspace-watermark** (data: none)
- **list** (data: none)
- **update** (data: payload*{archival_period_months, default_private, settings})
- **update-workspace-currency** (data: payload*{currency*})
- **update-workspace-watermark** (data: payload*{show_watermark*})

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: workspace-settings-list, workspace-settings-partial-update, get-user-permissions, get-workspace-currency, get-workspace-export-branding, get-workspace-watermark, list, update, update-workspace-currency, update-workspace-watermark

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
